page_title: RSO 3-3 OVI | Real Sociedad v Oviedo 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+9' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
90+5' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
90+2' 3 - 3 Eric Bailly (Real Oviedo) gets on the end of a cross and scores with a phenomenal header into the top left corner!
90+2' Good work from Oviedo as they win a corner.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alex Fores (Real Oviedo) comes onto the pitch so that Nicolas Fonseca can be given a rest.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' 3 - 2 Goal! A great through ball by Goncalo Guedes sets up Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 3:2.
87' 2 - 2 Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) finds the back of the net after rising highest in the penalty area to head the ball inside the left post!
86' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Vinas departs the field of play to be replaced by Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo).
81' Jose Munuera shows the yellow card to Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) for a heavy challenge.
77' Here is a change. Jon Gorrotxategi is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
76' Alberto Reina just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) replaces him.
76' That's the end of the game for Kwasi Sibo, who is replaced by Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo).
76' The substitution is prepared. Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Haissem Hassan.
73' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
73' Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
71' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards goal, but Aaron Escandell makes a magnificent save!
70' The foul by Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Munuera.
70' Real Sociedad enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
68' Oviedo players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
64' 1 - 2 Goal! Sergio Gomez picks out Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the top left corner with a header from close range. 1:2.
62' The ball goes out of play and Oviedo have been awarded a corner kick.
60' The total number of attempts is 4:9.
56' Alvaro Odriozola is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad).
55' The game is interrupted now, Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) replaces Pablo Marin.
53' It is time for a substitution. Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) is on for Jon Aramburu.
52' 0 - 2 Goal! Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
52' The referee blows his whistle, Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
50' 0 - 1 Goal! Haissem Hassan swings the ball deep into the box and finds Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the top left corner. 0:1.
50' The ball is out of play and Oviedo manage to earn a corner.
48' One of the Real Sociedad players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
47' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' It's time for a substitution. Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) comes on in place of Benat Turrientes.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Jose Munuera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
44' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
43' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Aaron Escandell is alert and denies him.

42' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
42' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
40' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. It's a throw-in for Real Sociedad.
39' Neat passing move from Real Sociedad in order to create new attacking opportunities.
37' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.

34' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
32' Today's referee Jose Munuera rightly decides to book Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) for his harsh tackle.
32' A quickly taken corner by Oviedo.
31' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Oviedo have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Ball possession – 73:27.

29' Real Sociedad show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will take a throw-in.
28' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' The Real Sociedad players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
25' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Sociedad.
22' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman signals a throw-in for Real Sociedad.
21' The resulting corner from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
21' The free kick into the penalty area from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Real Sociedad will have a corner.
21' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Munuera blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Real Sociedad.
19' The corner by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.

18' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Aaron Escandell anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Sociedad.
17' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

17' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
15' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
15' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes.
13' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Alex Remiro has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
12' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
12' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
10' Aaron Escandell displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
9' Oviedo are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The ball is out of play. Oviedo will have a throw-in.
8' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
7' A dangerous looking corner kick from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is cleared to safety by the defence.

7' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
6' The game is interrupted. Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
5' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.

5' A nice pass finds Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic low shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Aaron Escandell pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
4' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) releases Pablo Marin, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
3' Jose Munuera interrupts the game. One of the players from Real Sociedad won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
2' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends an accurate short pass. Duje Caleta-Car controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
1' Real Sociedad keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Real Sociedad.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Oviedo will kick the game off.
Jose Munuera is the one to supervise the game today.
